summary: An AI robot avatar on a lunar base challenges viewers to swap social media scrolling for 15 minutes of daily English practice. The ad details a 30-day program combining expert lessons with private AI coaching. It ends with a call to action to download the English Seekho app for a 1-rupee trial.
